scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.deadcode:backend: cd backend && out=$(go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; echo 'Unreachable (dead) code found.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.deadcode: npm run deadcode:backend && npm run deadcode:frontend
scripts.arch:backend: cd backend && go run github.com/fe3dback/go-arch-lint@v1.15.0 check
scripts.arch: npm run arch:backend && npm run arch:frontend
scripts.cov:frontend: cd frontend && npm run test:cov && sed -i.bak 's|^SF:src/|SF:frontend/src/|' coverage/lcov.info && rm -f coverage/lcov.info.bak
scripts.cov: npm run cov:backend && npm run cov:frontend && npm run cov:e2e
scripts.sonar: npm run cov && npm run sonar:scan
